source: Policy wording Sections C.2 (p.30-32) and C.3 (p.32-33). Summaries are paraphrased; cite the clause text from policy_clauses.jsonl.

check_types.llm_judgement: retrieve clause and flag for human review

standard_exclusions.title: Investigation and evaluation
standard_exclusions.summary: Admission primarily for diagnostics/evaluation only; diagnostics not related to the diagnosis and treatment.

standard_exclusions.title: Rest cure, rehabilitation, respite care
standard_exclusions.summary: Admission primarily for enforced bed rest; custodial care; services for terminally ill people.

standard_exclusions.title: Obesity / weight control
standard_exclusions.summary: Obesity surgery excluded unless doctor-advised, protocol-supported, age >= 18, and BMI >= 40 (or >= 35 with listed severe comorbidity after failed less invasive methods).

standard_exclusions.title: Change-of-gender treatments
standard_exclusions.summary: Treatment to change body characteristics to those of the opposite sex.

standard_exclusions.title: Cosmetic or plastic surgery
standard_exclusions.summary: Excluded unless reconstruction after accident, burns or cancer, or certified medical necessity to remove direct and immediate health risk.

standard_exclusions.title: Hazardous or adventure sports
standard_exclusions.summary: Treatment due to professional participation in hazardous/adventure sports.

standard_exclusions.title: Breach of law
standard_exclusions.summary: Treatment arising from committing or attempting a breach of law with criminal intent.

standard_exclusions.title: Excluded providers
standard_exclusions.summary: Providers on the insurer's published excluded list; only stabilisation payable in life-threatening cases or accidents.

standard_exclusions.title: Alcohol, drug and substance abuse
standard_exclusions.summary: Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or addictive conditions and consequences.

standard_exclusions.title: Health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas
standard_exclusions.summary: Treatment at such establishments or where admission is arranged wholly or partly for domestic reasons.

standard_exclusions.title: Dietary supplements
standard_exclusions.summary: Non-prescription supplements (vitamins, minerals, organic substances) unless prescribed as part of hospitalization or day care.

standard_exclusions.title: Refractive error
standard_exclusions.summary: Correction of eyesight for refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres.

standard_exclusions.title: Unproven treatments
standard_exclusions.summary: Treatments lacking significant medical documentation of effectiveness.

standard_exclusions.title: Sterility and infertility
standard_exclusions.summary: Contraception, sterilization, assisted reproduction (IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, ICSI), gestational surrogacy, reversal of sterilization.

standard_exclusions.title: Maternity
standard_exclusions.summary: Childbirth-related expenses (including caesarean), miscarriage unless due to accident, lawful termination of pregnancy; ectopic pregnancy is not excluded.

specific_exclusions.title: War and nuclear/chemical/biological events
specific_exclusions.summary: War, invasion, insurrection, nuclear, chemical or biological attack, radiation.

specific_exclusions.title: Aggregate deductible
specific_exclusions.summary: Claim amount falling within the aggregate deductible if opted.

specific_exclusions.title: Intentional self-injury
specific_exclusions.summary: Intentional self-injury, attempted suicide or suicide.

specific_exclusions.title: Military operations
specific_exclusions.summary: Participation in naval, military or air force operations.

specific_exclusions.title: Investigative treatment for sleep apnoea / general debility
specific_exclusions.summary: Investigative treatment for sleep-apnoea, general debility or exhaustion.

specific_exclusions.title: Congenital external anomalies
specific_exclusions.summary: Congenital external diseases, defects or anomalies.

specific_exclusions.title: Spinal manipulation and similar
specific_exclusions.summary: Spinal subluxation adjustment, skeletal manipulation, muscle stimulation, except fractures (not hairline) and dislocations of mandible and extremities.

specific_exclusions.title: Circumcision
specific_exclusions.summary: Unless necessitated by illness or injury and part of treatment.

specific_exclusions.title: Vaccination
specific_exclusions.summary: Vaccination and inoculation except post animal bite treatment.

specific_exclusions.title: Non-medical expenses
specific_exclusions.summary: Items in Annexure B. Does NOT apply when Protect Benefit (B.2.3) is in force.

specific_exclusions.title: Hearing aids, spectacles, contact lenses
specific_exclusions.summary: Provision or fitting of these items.

specific_exclusions.title: Alopecia and baldness
specific_exclusions.summary: Treatment and associated expenses, wigs, hair replacement, optometric therapy.

specific_exclusions.title: Artificial limbs and external devices
specific_exclusions.summary: Prostheses, corrective devices, external durable equipment, wheelchairs, crutches, oxygen concentrator (asthma/COPD), cochlear implants unless due to accident; intra-operative use excepted.

specific_exclusions.title: Unreasonable or unnecessary treatment
specific_exclusions.summary: Not reasonable charge and not medically necessary; drugs/treatments without a prescription.

specific_exclusions.title: Permanent exclusions in schedule
specific_exclusions.summary: Conditions permanently excluded and accepted by the policyholder in the Policy Schedule.
